outcome: agreement between clinical and ultrasound estimation of fetal weight
accuracy of clinical examination for fetal weight estimation
cohort: 250 pregnant women at term pregnancy at Divisional Head Quarter Hospital, Mirpur Azad Jamu Kashmir
finding: There was a significant agreement between clinical and ultrasound estimation of fetal weight (Kappa = 0.4491), suggesting clinical examination can be a reliable alternative when ultrasound is unavailable.
